counting_rule: Each denominator counts exact installed research record identities in its own category. Their sum is not a linguistic test-set size, rule count, theorem count or Arabic coverage measure. In particular these are not the uncreated T11 120 usage cases.
source_identity_boundary: The imported JSON bytes are replayable research evidence. Their citations and prior page-review statements remain attributed reports; primary PDF/edition collation is not replayed or authenticated by this import.
existing_work_boundary: Related records retain their exact current path, pointer, source hash and scope. The relationship is not identity of edition, exhaustiveness, parser implementation coverage or proof of fidelity. Qatr matn and sharh are distinct witnesses.
template_boundary: 20 nominal mujarrad templates belong to a declared conventional profile. They are not a classifier for semantic jamid, all names, foreign/proper/augmented forms or a license for every display example. The 27 existing derivational projections have a different denominator and semantic_projection NONE.
interpretation_boundary: 15 engineering contracts are authored designs informed by reviewed chapters. The prior shared-meaning experiment remains PROPOSED_NOT_EXECUTED.
closure_obligations: Exact declared universe, lexicon/grammar/convention version, and relevant distinguishing queries.
Independent inventory with exceptions, dialects, attribution and admissible alternatives.
Source-to-formal interpretation fidelity in both directions.
Compositional interpretation preservation for every declared constructor.
Actual encoder/decoder interpretation preservation under stated source context.
Premise acquisition, implementation refinement and native verification.
Independent linguistic/reference/world evidence when such judgments are requested.
historical_preservation: No historical source catalog, operator registry, original src file or original Makefile is changed by this source inventory.
inventory_role: Indexed research families, templates and engineering obligations; not an installed accepted-language law.
